notes.note: Reviewed host-design and shared-reference follow-up: shipped in-process definitions qualify static frame mounting without an MCP client; the current runtime inventory App-read adapters still map found projections to unavailable. The browser evidence uses a seeded saved result from an authorized inventory snapshot and does not qualify production publication. Existing SDK/shipped-docs CSP and qualification limits remain accurate. Shared predicate is only a cheap candidate filter; connected or shipped definition membership remains authoritative.
